test_checks.description: Logger emits each entry as a single JSON object with at minimum timestamp, level, message keys.
A logged mobile number is masked to last 4 digits; the full number never appears unmasked.
Aadhaar and PAN references are masked with the same partial-reveal rule.
A payload containing all three PII fields never has any raw value appear as a substring of the emitted JSON.
logging_service.py and pii_mask.py import only from Types and Config.
test_checks.command: cd backend && grep -rnE '^(from|import)[[:space:]]+app\.(repository|api)' src/app/service/logging_service.py src/app/lib/pii_mask.py || echo NONE_FOUND

test_checks.description: Unauthenticated request to a protected route receives HTTP 401 (including a malformed bearer token).
A subscriber-role request to a CSR-only endpoint receives HTTP 403.
A subscriber requesting another subscriber's data (ID mismatch) receives HTTP 403.

A CSR or admin principal accesses endpoints scoped to their own role without a 403 (test_csr_or_admin_can_access_their_scoped_endpoint_without_403 is parametrized over [Role.CSR, Role.ADMIN], collecting as 2 items); a subscriber accessing their own data succeeds; staff roles are not subject to subscriber ownership checks.

An integration test exercises all four auth cases (401 x2, 403 x2, scoped-success x3-including-CSR/ADMIN-parametrization, own-data-success) against a running FastAPI TestClient — 8 collected items across 7 test functions, one of which is parametrized over 2 roles.
test_checks.command: cd backend && uv run pytest -q tests/integration/test_auth.py
